author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಭಾವನೆಯ ಹಿಡಿದಿಡುತ ನಿಸ್ಪೃಹತೆ ಗಳಿಸುತಿರೆ
ನೋವುಗಳ ಬಂಧದಿಂ ಹೊರಬರುವೆ ನೀನು
ಜೀವಿತದ ಅನುಕ್ಷಣವು ಅನುಭಾವ ಕೊರತೆಯಿರೆ
ಜೀವನವೆ ದುಸ್ತರವು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you rein in your emotions and gain detachment,
you will come out of the bonds of pain;
if every moment of life lacks inner experience,
life itself becomes hard to cross, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Mastering emotion and growing detached frees us from suffering. But a life without inner depth, moment to moment, is hard to get through.
